full_details: Heminges counted seven days to Easter Monday and no bill on the door. Garnish refused another paste. The book stayed one book. Sam sang the cuckoo on the breath, and the note was clear. Kemp asked for a laugh and did not get one. Arthur's hooks were still split, and nobody sent for the seamstress. At the table the loaf was a finger and a half short of the notch, still a penny, and not on a pan. You paid threepence and did not open the coffer. At night the almanac had the full moon. You did not begin a king, and you did not add a word under one answer.
one_sentence: You rehearsed the comedy in a dark house, Sam sang clear, and at dinner the loaf was still a finger and a half short.
title: Seven days, and the same short loaf
